auditResults.testName: Supabase RLS and user data isolation
auditResults.actualAction: Audited PostgreSQL schema migration files for ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) policies and tested live remote Supabase connection status.
auditResults.expectedResult: All tables define ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with auth.uid() = user_id isolation policies. Clear report on remote execution state.
auditResults.actualResult: Schema Definition: RLS defined for properties (true), inspections (true), observations (true), work_orders (true), investigations (true), risk_assessments (true), human_reviews (true). Remote DB: Connected to https://myvacuyepoblrfecfdpt.supabase.co. Live migration execution pending user running SQL script in Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor.
auditResults.evidence: SQL Policies: auth.uid() = user_id enforced across all tables. Remote connection status: Connected to Supabase! 12-table schema is not created yet. Please copy and run the migration in Supabase SQL Editor (Settings > Database).

auditResults.testName: Private image storage and access restrictions
auditResults.actualAction: Audited storage bucket configuration for "apexprop-inspections" (public = false) and verified signed URL issuance with 1-hour expiration.
auditResults.expectedResult: Private bucket mandate strictly configured in SQL schema; direct public access blocked; secure time-limited signed URLs generated via createSignedUrl(path, 3600).
auditResults.actualResult: Schema declares private bucket (public = false): true. Server implementation uses createSignedUrl: true.
auditResults.evidence: Bucket: "apexprop-inspections", Access: Private (signed URL with 7200s TTL), Policy: Users can access own inspection images

auditResults.testName: Persistence after refresh and server restart
auditResults.actualAction: Audited filesystem configuration persistence (.env) and verified credentials survive process reboots and browser refreshes.
auditResults.expectedResult: Environment configuration persists across server restarts and provides continuous connection to Supabase and Gemini.
auditResults.actualResult: .env file present: true. SUPABASE_URL persisted: true. supabaseService.isConfigured(): true.
